preconditions.description: The number of intersections in Mike's city is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each shortcut allows walking from intersection i to intersection a_i, where a_i is at least i and at most n.

preconditions.expression: a_i <= a_{i+1} for all i < n
preconditions.description: The shortcuts are non-decreasing in their destination intersections.

postconditions.description: The output list m contains n integers, one for each intersection.
The energy required to reach intersection 1 is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(m[i] >= m[i-1] for i in range(1, n))
postconditions.description: The energy required to reach each subsequent intersection is at least as much as it was to reach the previous intersection.

postconditions.expression: all(m[i] == min(m[i], m[a_i-1] + 1) for i in range(1, n))
postconditions.description: For each intersection i, the minimum energy required to reach it is the minimum of either directly reaching it or reaching a_i-1 and then using the shortcut to reach i.
